page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc9i.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs utilizing an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a base frequency of 3.4 GHz. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance configuration does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for persistent data. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. There are no graphics processing units integrated into this instance type, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance in the compute-optimized tier, offering high compute density relative to memory capacity. This configuration is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring sustained CPU processing power without massive memory footprints, though the lack of local storage requires accounting for external storage latency. Appropriate workloads include compute-heavy tasks, batch processing, web serving, and application servers that do not require local disk caching or GPU acceleration.
